observation: A stable sidebar and aligned review rows sit below one reserve readout.
lesson: Keep predictable navigation; reduce the oversized introduction when the candidate list grows.
verification_prompt: Can a returning user reach one cache path without rereading the overview?

observation: A floating horizontal navigation bar sits above a largely opaque content slab.
lesson: Material can distinguish navigation from evidence; this is a more structural glass treatment than a tinted sidebar.
verification_prompt: Does navigation remain legible over a busy desktop with reduced transparency enabled?

observation: Three metrics share a row and the review queue includes an explicit unselected document state.
lesson: Density can expose more evidence simultaneously; dark color itself contributes no scanning intelligence.
verification_prompt: Can long paths and an unknown ownership state fit at enlarged text size?

observation: A narrative report and a separate target column describe why categories deserve review.
lesson: Use this for explanation or a periodic report; prose is inefficient for comparing many individual files.
verification_prompt: Can the reader identify both recreation cost and the next file-level action?

observation: An original friendly disk character accompanies three explicit review steps.
lesson: A companion can introduce the task; a calm face must never imply the selected files are safe.
verification_prompt: Does the same tone still communicate a failed or irreversible action plainly?

observation: A yellow poster fills the left half while a plain bordered review panel holds the action.
lesson: Strong identity works when the decision area has a separate rhythm; the slogan consumes substantial working space.
verification_prompt: Can a genuine warning stand out against the already emphatic introduction?

observation: A large digital readout and labeled reserve setting resemble an instrument panel.
lesson: Borrow explicit units and set-point labeling; a physical-looking setting needs real accessible adjustment semantics.
verification_prompt: Can the target be changed by keyboard and distinguished from measured free space?

observation: Unequal summary cards emphasize free space and deficit above equal category tiles.
lesson: Asymmetry can establish priority while equal tiles remain categorical rather than proportional.
verification_prompt: Will users mistake equal category tiles for equal storage consumption?

observation: A typographic index aligns current, target and deficit on one baseline.
lesson: Compare related metrics using common alignment; retain enough room for reasons below the dramatic headline.
verification_prompt: Can users identify the units and meaning of all three numbers without relying on position?

observation: A plain task heading and three-step explanation lead into review.
lesson: Explicit action language is portable across styles; a mandatory wizard may burden repeat users.
verification_prompt: Can novices explain what Continue does and experts return directly to an unresolved item?

observation: A 34.6 GB candidate treemap sits beside an exact-value inspector.
lesson: Use area for composition, then rows for judgment; candidate area is neither disk capacity nor deletion permission.
verification_prompt: Can users state the denominator and identify the smaller category exactly?

observation: A menu-bar status proposal opens a compact reserve panel and describes notification policy.
lesson: Peripheral monitoring should surface meaningful changes and blockers; quiet appearance is not a running monitor.
verification_prompt: Does a newly blocked scan become noticeable without repeated unchanged alerts?

observation: A pixel disk glyph and rectangular desktop chrome surround modern review rows.
lesson: Historical economy of symbols can supply character without inheriting historical target sizes.
verification_prompt: Can every decorative menu be distinguished from a functioning command?

observation: A yellow-purple identity panel uses repeated geometric marks beside a steady list.
lesson: Expressiveness is strongest when confined to a recognizable region; marks carry no byte meaning.
verification_prompt: Can participants tell decoration from progress when the palette is removed?

observation: A leaf-like solid and rounded vertical panel accompany an ordinary evidence list.
lesson: Organic silhouettes can soften a brand; they establish neither ecological savings nor safer cleanup.
verification_prompt: Can the plant motif be removed without changing any storage interpretation?

observation: A command field and matching action preview explain that execution opens review.
lesson: Speed should shorten navigation while preserving consequence visibility; fuzzy matching cannot authorize removal.
verification_prompt: Does Enter on a partial command open the stated review without deleting anything?

observation: A lavender sidebar shell has softly separated panels, unlike B's floating horizontal navigation.
lesson: This adds a material finish to a conventional shell, not another navigation philosophy.
verification_prompt: Compare against an opaque version with the same hierarchy before attributing benefit to glass.

observation: The same sidebar hierarchy appears in cool blue with subdued frosted-looking planes.
lesson: Frost and tint need a distinguishable functional role before becoming separate design rules.
verification_prompt: Can users read the smallest metadata at both increased contrast and ordinary contrast settings?

observation: Two tall panels separate reserve status from the review action against a blue frame.
lesson: A split can localize a transient decision; the static frame does not demonstrate flyout behavior.
verification_prompt: Test opening, dismissal and return focus in a native prototype before calling it a flyout pattern.

observation: Gloss is concentrated in the top chrome while the sidebar and evidence remain pale.
lesson: Historical gel can live in chrome; most of this screen's usability comes from its ordinary rows.
verification_prompt: Does the highlight ever compete with the active window or selected row indication?

observation: A cyan frame and top highlight surround the same sidebar arrangement.
lesson: Aero and Aqua references do not create different workflows in this rendering.
verification_prompt: Compare selection and focus states without the frame colors.

observation: A dark instrument layout isolates the deficit in a separate top-right block.
lesson: Metric grouping is the useful distinction; smoked material remains optional.
verification_prompt: Check whether free space and deficit can be read without mistaking either for candidate size.

observation: A pale split layout adds angled spectral-looking background planes.
lesson: Prismatic edges are identity treatment, while the two-panel decision structure is inherited.
verification_prompt: Remove the background planes and confirm that no category meaning disappears.

observation: Fine vertical ribs appear around a green sidebar shell.
lesson: Fluting should remain behind non-reading areas; the current composition offers texture, not new interaction.
verification_prompt: Check small text and focus outlines against ribs at normal display scale.

observation: Outlined instrument panels use repeated fine borders and a separate deficit block.
lesson: Precision is conveyed by alignment and labels; decorative ticks must not imply measured calibration.
verification_prompt: Ask what every line measures; remove those that appear quantitative without a scale.

observation: Tall rounded panels replace the squared split slabs.
lesson: Corner shape alters perceived softness but does not establish a distinct crystal interaction system.
verification_prompt: Measure lost content width at large text and a narrow window.

observation: A peach poster composition pairs a large reserve panel with a rounded review panel.
lesson: The bubble label overstates the visible uniqueness; use it as a rounded material recipe.
verification_prompt: Verify that the review action remains serious when a costly rebuild is involved.

observation: Colored angular planes frame an otherwise conventional light sidebar screen.
lesson: Stained accents can establish an edge identity; geometry is not a storage map.
verification_prompt: Ask which shapes correspond to bytes; the correct answer is none.

observation: A dark two-column slab gives reserve and candidates separate vertical regions.
lesson: Use this when status should remain visible through a review task; it loses the instrument panel's explicit policy block.
verification_prompt: Can the review consequences remain visible when the right pane scrolls?

observation: Quiet tinted panels appear almost opaque and retain the same sidebar hierarchy.
lesson: Mica-inspired tint and transparent glass are different material claims despite similar thumbnails.
verification_prompt: Validate the intended native material and accessibility behavior rather than reproducing a screenshot tint.

observation: Gray translucent-looking instrument panels have low visual separation in the sheet.
lesson: Brushed identity needs stronger functional boundaries before becoming a reusable control treatment.
verification_prompt: Inspect component contrast and selected, disabled and focused states on a full-size prototype.

observation: A muted green shell preserves the ribbed sidebar composition with gentler edges.
lesson: Satin is a finish variation; retain it as an option within a material family.
verification_prompt: Use identical tasks to compare satin and plain opaque surfaces before claiming reduced strain.

observation: Striped title chrome and monochrome rectangular panels reuse the sidebar shell.
lesson: Borrow economical edges and glyphs, not one-bit constraints on modern file text.
verification_prompt: Test long Unicode paths, keyboard focus and current pointer targets.

observation: Gray bevels and bolder sans-serif type replace monochrome lines within the same shell.
lesson: Platinum depth is a state-language candidate only if pressed and disabled states are defined.
verification_prompt: Can a user distinguish a raised button from a raised decorative panel?

observation: A dark title strip and hard split panels suggest an early office desktop.
lesson: The useful organization is the two-panel separation, not small legacy typography.
verification_prompt: Keep current readable metrics while testing whether historical chrome adds any navigation value.

observation: Teal frame, gray surfaces and navy title chrome recolor a beveled sidebar.
lesson: Nostalgia is identity evidence, not evidence of recovery safety.
verification_prompt: Show a real error and verify it is not visually confused with the navy brand chrome.

observation: Optimistic blue gloss surrounds the recurring light sidebar screen.
lesson: The XP reference contributes a period palette more than a separate content grammar.
verification_prompt: Compare its active and inactive window states with macOS conventions.

observation: A vivid blue frame surrounds a pale two-panel workspace.
lesson: A saturated historical signal can be borrowed, but warning colors still need distinct labels.
verification_prompt: Check whether orange and blue accents, if added, collide with status meanings.

observation: A cream frame and compact top tab treatment surround sidebar content.
lesson: Tabbed identity must not compete with native window title and tab behavior.
verification_prompt: Can users locate app navigation versus system window controls?

observation: Heavy gray instrument panes isolate the deficit from the current-space readout.
lesson: Retain the metric partition while reducing chrome if paths require more horizontal room.
verification_prompt: Test a dense file inspector with both large text and a long package path.

observation: Blue-framed split panels closely resemble the earlier office interpretation.
lesson: Treat this as a historically labeled variant with limited structural novelty.
verification_prompt: Require a demonstrable behavior difference before promoting it beyond a reference recipe.

observation: Sand-colored recessed instrument panels repeat the current/deficit/review arrangement.
lesson: A workstation palette can unify modules; it does not justify a decorative command dock.
verification_prompt: Inventory each apparent control and remove any with no action.

observation: Purple-gray split panes change the visual period cue while preserving the same task order.
lesson: Historical breadth is useful for taste exploration, but a palette is not a new workflow.
verification_prompt: Test whether the violet treatment changes readability, not merely preference.

observation: A monospaced green manifest displays values and one explicit review button.
lesson: A readable audit transcript can serve experts; it should not require users to know shell syntax.
verification_prompt: Can a pointer-only user review one item and understand the action's effect?

observation: Amber replaces green in the same terminal manifest.
lesson: Record this as a color variant and preserve warning semantics separately.
verification_prompt: Can an amber error be recognized when the entire interface is already amber?

observation: Blue paired panels use monospaced capacity and candidate text.
lesson: Paired browsing could support comparison, but this static split does not yet implement a dual-pane manager.
verification_prompt: Prototype independent selection, transfer preview and keyboard movement before adopting the metaphor.

observation: Green monospaced numerals and dark recessed panels imitate a small LCD instrument.
lesson: Compact digits can supply character; exact units and full paths need ordinary readable text.
verification_prompt: Check whether decimal precision survives scaling and whether the largest value fits.

observation: Blocky typography supplies most of the cartridge-era character in a poster layout.
lesson: Pixel identity belongs in short headings; filenames need modern glyph coverage.
verification_prompt: Check multilingual paths and avoid using a score or achievement for deletion.

observation: Dark beveled instrument panes have a restrained blue highlight.
lesson: The arcade name exceeds the visible distinction from the microconsole; neither should turn bytes into a score.
verification_prompt: Compare both without labels and record whether their structure can actually be distinguished.

observation: A blue-gray terminal manifest replaces phosphor color but keeps fixed-column reading.
lesson: A compact service bulletin can communicate states if text labels survive color removal.
verification_prompt: Test wrapping and alignment at enlarged text and narrow window widths.

observation: A metal-like compact instrument repeats the same metric and policy grouping.
lesson: Microconsole identity is useful at menu-bar scale only if every visible meter reflects real data.
verification_prompt: Map each meter to a quantity or remove it from the functional layer.

observation: A welcome headline and simple bordered panels evoke an early personal page.
lesson: Direct links and readable content are transferable; novelty and fake hyperlinks are not.
verification_prompt: Check which underlined elements actually navigate and where focus lands.

observation: A silver poster with rounded cards concentrates chrome in its outer surface.
lesson: Y2K reflection can live in a title treatment while the review remains flat.
verification_prompt: Check glare-like gradients over status text in light and dark environments.

observation: A dark poster includes background grid lines and pale blue accents.
lesson: A horizon grid is atmosphere, not an axis; urgency should come from actual status.
verification_prompt: Ask users whether the grid represents disk sectors or time and correct ambiguity.

observation: A lavender split-panel desktop supplies a subdued vaporwave cue.
lesson: This rendering lacks much of the proposed collage vocabulary; keep its historical claim modest.
verification_prompt: Require visible compositional evidence before describing the result as a rich period reconstruction.

observation: Sky-blue chrome surrounds a calm poster and review area.
lesson: Gloss and blue-green associations supply identity without evidence of environmental benefit.
verification_prompt: Ensure no copy converts a natural motif into a carbon-saving claim.

observation: A red accent and aligned rows sit within a warm sidebar ledger.
lesson: Use the strict alignment as a scalable operational grid; the Swiss label is broader than this one layout.
verification_prompt: Can 30 variable-length rows retain alignment and explicit consequences?

observation: A poster hierarchy and subtle background geometry organize two main planes.
lesson: Functional geometric identity needs more than naming circles and triangles after a movement.
verification_prompt: Identify which geometric feature aids grouping and which is simply decoration.

observation: Hard black compartment edges separate a monochrome split layout.
lesson: Orthogonal compartments can clarify grouping; their areas must not masquerade as category size.
verification_prompt: Compare against X17 and verify users understand that only the latter encodes bytes by area.

observation: A forceful title and red emphasis frame an otherwise familiar poster composition.
lesson: Reserve disruptive emphasis for a meaningful message; routine deficit is not automatically an emergency.
verification_prompt: Can urgency vary across normal, warning and critical states without further visual escalation?

observation: Fine double outlines and serif accents decorate a dark instrument.
lesson: Ceremonial precision can frame metrics, but this is a limited Deco interpretation rather than a full system.
verification_prompt: Check whether ornament competes with separators and the actionable focus ring.

observation: Serif typography and rounded double borders create a quiet botanical folio impression.
lesson: Curvature can shape a perimeter while the reading order stays conventional.
verification_prompt: At small sizes, can users separate ornamental lines from interactive outlines?

observation: Peach split panes include faint geometric interruptions around the background.
lesson: The original N has more visible Memphis character; this study mostly varies material and tone.
verification_prompt: Compare blinded thumbnails before claiming a separate composition vocabulary.

observation: A warm poster uses rounded planes and limited visible distortion.
lesson: Keep the psychedelic claim narrow; expressive typography must still preserve short-message recognition.
verification_prompt: Test the headline at a glance and keep operational text undistorted.

observation: An offset heading and angled background planes disrupt an otherwise steady poster grid.
lesson: Disruption can signal identity when the data baseline remains stable.
verification_prompt: Verify that reading order and keyboard order agree despite visual offsets.

observation: Hard offset shadows and a stamped-looking heading frame split panels.
lesson: Roughness can communicate repair culture while the evidence language stays exact.
verification_prompt: Check whether distress or paper edges look like an error or an unselected state.

observation: Soft peach printing cues sit behind a clean poster and review panel.
lesson: Use ink overlap in ornament only; E11 demonstrates the overprint mechanism more visibly.
verification_prompt: Keep all numerals single, aligned and free of simulated misregistration.

observation: Serif type, thin rules and cream sidebar panels suggest a printed record.
lesson: Material weight should not weaken control affordances or resemble disabled ink.
verification_prompt: Test button and text contrast independently of the paper effect.

observation: A large serif headline dominates a two-column editorial poster.
lesson: Editorial pacing suits a short explanation; D offers a richer reason-and-action narrative.
verification_prompt: Can users reach file review without scrolling past redundant prose?

observation: A raw monochrome split uses direct headings and strong rectangular boundaries.
lesson: Directness is reusable if controls retain conventional semantics and focus treatment.
verification_prompt: Run the review path using keyboard alone with no reliance on color.

observation: A blue handbook-like sidebar organizes clean numbered review sections.
lesson: Institutional order can clarify categories but must not grant uncertain recommendations false authority.
verification_prompt: Can users identify unknown evidence as readily as the confident headline?

observation: Dense black optical marks appear behind a stable instrument cluster.
lesson: High-frequency ornament adds little to the decision and risks visual interference.
verification_prompt: Offer a plain version and compare reading comfort before retaining the pattern.

observation: Soft shadows and rounded peach poster panels suggest clay volume.
lesson: Softness can define a brand, but shadow alone should not define a control.
verification_prompt: Remove shadows and verify that buttons remain visibly interactive.

observation: Continuous gray raised panels blur distinctions between instrument regions.
lesson: Neumorphic styling requires explicit boundaries and state indicators beyond depth.
verification_prompt: Check selected, focused, disabled and pressed controls at full scale before reuse.

observation: Layered paper-like split panels have visible offset edges.
lesson: Elevation can express grouping; connected folds in X37 express sequence, which this version does not.
verification_prompt: Ask whether the two panels are steps or simultaneous categories and make the intended relation explicit.

observation: Heavy outlines and offset shadows surround an approachable poster.
lesson: Comic contours can make identity memorable while the evidence remains matter-of-fact.
verification_prompt: Verify no celebratory shape or message rewards the amount deleted.

observation: Lavender rounded panels supply cuteness with little visible character illustration.
lesson: Do not claim a companion interaction from corner radius alone; E contains a concrete character.
verification_prompt: Test whether serious consequence wording survives the friendly tone.

observation: Cream sidebar panels and quiet rules suggest a notebook more than actual handwriting.
lesson: Handmade cues should stay peripheral to paths and amounts.
verification_prompt: Check that a real file annotation cannot be confused with decorative marks.

observation: Flat outlined split panes use crisp offset shadows.
lesson: Cel shading can distinguish planes if selected and disabled states use independent signals.
verification_prompt: Can users identify the active panel with shadow and color removed?

observation: A slanted background motif accompanies a normal green split panel.
lesson: Perspective suggests organization but does not accurately compare volumes.
verification_prompt: Ask whether the illustrated volume represents bytes; provide exact text and reject implied measurement.

observation: Dotted stitch-like borders frame warm sidebar panels.
lesson: Archive material can communicate care while preserving ownership and source labels.
verification_prompt: Can a user tell the app's frame from the content of a personal document preview?

observation: A brown wood-like frame surrounds flat instrument readouts.
lesson: Texture is most compatible with evidence when confined to the surround.
verification_prompt: Remove grain beneath small labels and compare scanability.

observation: Bolt-like corners and stamped instrument labels create a service-tool identity.
lesson: Apparent hardware controls need real functions; hazard motifs should not become routine visual noise.
verification_prompt: Inventory every bolt, stripe and button for accidental affordance or warning meaning.

observation: Near-white planes, thin text and a monochrome readout produce a quiet sidebar utility.
lesson: Reduced color can simplify the shell while explicit status labels carry urgency.
verification_prompt: Can a blocked cleanup be noticed in the same quiet visual system?

observation: Green serif poster panels carry a restrained care metaphor.
lesson: Botanical identity adds no evidence that storage is growing naturally or cleanup is environmentally beneficial.
verification_prompt: Replace leaves with neutral shapes and confirm all data interpretation is unchanged.

observation: Warm green split panels and a technical motif imply stewardship.
lesson: Repair values can shape copy and process; the screenshot does not demonstrate sustainability outcomes.
verification_prompt: Check every ecological claim for a measured basis before allowing it into product copy.

observation: A dark audit manifest has sharp framing and a luminous action accent.
lesson: Diagnostic identity is compatible with a readable log if glitch never touches evidence.
verification_prompt: Test noisy and failed states without animation, color dependence or corrupted text.

observation: A blue drafting grid and monospaced labels frame the current/deficit instrument.
lesson: Drafting precision should come from labeled measurements, not decorative construction lines.
verification_prompt: Ask which lines are scales and ensure every real scale has units and bounds.

observation: A leaf border, bound-looking folio and serif headline separate identity from review.
lesson: Arts and Crafts offers questions about making and care, not a license to equate floral styling with that philosophy.
verification_prompt: Describe one actual product practice expressing care, beyond adding the leaf border.

observation: Repeated arcing contours sit above the reserve value beside an uninterrupted evidence column.
lesson: The rendered contours are a limited print-inspired motif, not a convincing landscape or complete cultural translation.
verification_prompt: Check any historical description against what is actually visible and the museum source.

observation: Floating red and black planes occupy empty space separate from the literal capacity figure.
lesson: Abstract geometry can supply identity if the product makes its non-quantitative status clear.
verification_prompt: Compare with the treemap and ask which area is proportional to bytes.

observation: Cut-letter blocks disrupt the headline while the review column remains conventional.
lesson: Collage can be bounded to expression; filenames and confirmations need a stable reading sequence.
verification_prompt: Read the heading aloud and verify that assistive reading order conveys the intended phrase.

observation: A warm serif spread uses fine horizontal texture beside plain evidence.
lesson: Editorial period cues should not import class associations or pretend to confer credibility.
verification_prompt: Replace the texture with blank paper and compare whether the report still has useful hierarchy.

observation: An outline globe and explanatory headline sit beside the candidate facts.
lesson: Educational framing needs an actual explanation model; a globe is not evidence of understanding.
verification_prompt: Ask a reader to explain cache recreation cost after viewing the lesson, not merely recognize the illustration.

observation: A recessed capacity display and circular target label form a cassette-like instrument.
lesson: Separate measured quantity from adjustable set point, and name any future control explicitly.
verification_prompt: Can the target be recognized as a preference rather than a current measurement?

observation: A bright title ribbon and diagonal marks lead to a broad evidence strip.
lesson: Directional ornament can focus the header without organizing the actual workflow.
verification_prompt: Compare with X30; can users identify sequence only where the design really supplies steps?

observation: Muted green-gray background fields sit behind two quiet foreground blocks.
lesson: Atmosphere differs from structure; the same spatial recipe appears in the aurora study.
verification_prompt: Use identical content and compare contrast before treating the urban mood as functional improvement.

observation: A serif specimen and prominent capacity figure share a ruled folio.
lesson: A type scale can provide identity and hierarchy while the specimen itself remains optional.
verification_prompt: Check whether Aa / 150 is mistaken for the actual reserve target readout.

observation: Three overlapping translucent circles form a visibly overprinted motif above the capacity text.
lesson: This is a useful ink-layer exercise, but overlap can resemble a Venn diagram without set semantics.
verification_prompt: Ask what each circle represents and remove any implied analytical claim.

observation: Fine hatching and restrained rules evoke an engraved inventory.
lesson: Hatching is a material cue; precise records require provenance fields beyond visual meticulousness.
verification_prompt: Inspect whether texture impairs small labels at a standard desktop zoom.

observation: A silver-blue ribbon separates identity from a flat review and deficit area.
lesson: Concentrate reflective material in one non-reading band; keep action contrast independent.
verification_prompt: Can users locate Review when its fill closely matches the metallic surrounding color?

observation: A pastel foil-like gradient replaces the chrome ribbon in the same composition.
lesson: Foil is a surface variant and should not be represented as a new workflow or native optical material.
verification_prompt: Check contrast across the full gradient and in the opaque fallback.

observation: A softly illuminated backdrop supports an opaque inspector and separate reserve block.
lesson: Atmospheric depth works when the reading plane remains stable.
verification_prompt: Test the exact content with transparency and motion reduced in the eventual native prototype.

observation: Three equal jelly-like category tiles sit between a reserve band and a review dock.
lesson: Equal tile size communicates membership, not equal byte magnitude or equal safety.
verification_prompt: Can users explain why Documents has no number while the other tiles show estimates?

observation: An ivory-and-blue instrument uses a circular target label and a separate measured readout.
lesson: Porcelain is a finish; target/current separation is the transferable relationship.
verification_prompt: Can a screen-reader user distinguish the set point from a gauge without seeing the circle?

observation: Dark foreground planes use shadows to separate reserve and evidence.
lesson: Depth can group content, but keyboard focus must follow the task rather than z-position.
verification_prompt: Traverse the eventual panel by keyboard and verify no context is hidden behind layers.

observation: Faceted landscape geometry sits behind an exact-value inspector.
lesson: The polygon vocabulary is decorative and unsuitable for unlabelled size comparison.
verification_prompt: Check whether a larger polygon is incorrectly read as a larger cache.

observation: Wireframe loops sit around a solid reserve card and evidence panel.
lesson: An inspection metaphor should not imply a completed scan or a measured directory graph.
verification_prompt: Ask whether the loops represent files; contrast explicitly with a real partition diagram.

observation: Broad gray-green planes and faint grain repeat the ribbon composition.
lesson: A durable material impression can coexist with a plain data surface, but cannot prove trustworthy recommendations.
verification_prompt: Check focus indicators against the subtly textured material.

observation: A cool folio and opaque ledger put evidence text beside the reserve readout.
lesson: Transparency is a metaphor; audit completeness depends on actual ownership, use and recreation checks.
verification_prompt: Can a missing evidence field remain visibly unknown despite the confident visual treatment?

observation: A luminous band, three equal tiles and a grounded review dock share the jelly layout.
lesson: Docking the action can stabilize the task; prismatic color must not imply selection or risk.
verification_prompt: Can users find the action and identify excluded documents after color is removed?

observation: Long calm capsules retain the same reserve, category and action hierarchy.
lesson: This is a component recipe within a shared layout, with width and wrapping tradeoffs.
verification_prompt: Test three long localized category names at a narrow window width.

observation: A branching route separates review progression from an excluded-document branch.
lesson: A visible off-ramp can make exclusion understandable; a route diagram must not imply elapsed time.
verification_prompt: Can users identify the next unresolved step and explain why documents branch away?

observation: Large departure-style rows align categories, sizes and pending actions.
lesson: The board metaphor is useful because it foregrounds pending work; split-flap animation adds no necessary information.
verification_prompt: With 20 rows and long names, can users still find one pending action quickly?

observation: Two labeled signal flags accompany a plain candidate manifest.
lesson: Labels can make an invented signal usable; do not borrow the authority of standardized maritime flags.
verification_prompt: Can users interpret every signal without prior maritime knowledge or color perception?

observation: Each of three category groups displays six repeated symbols despite different byte values.
lesson: Repeated icons invite a count inference even when a caption denies it; one icon per category would be clearer.
verification_prompt: Ask whether six symbols mean six files; remove repetition if that inference persists.

observation: Three overlapping drawer tabs expose small category records.
lesson: Indexed records suggest a navigation model, but overlaps and truncation may hide comparisons.
verification_prompt: Prototype keyboard tab selection and confirm that the selected drawer has an unambiguous label.

observation: A dark optical desk isolates one 31.2 GB record beside a numbered rail.
lesson: Aperture focus supports inspection but hides neighboring values; retain a visible route back to the full list.
verification_prompt: Can users compare two records without losing the selected item's context?

observation: Perforations frame a monospaced candidate manifest.
lesson: Perforation can provide material identity but does not encode a command or a file attribute.
verification_prompt: Ask which marks are actionable and strip any misleading code-like ornament.

observation: An oversized mechanical counter sits beside the 150 GB target and pending-review text.
lesson: Stable digits can communicate reserve status; odometer animation would imply continuous measurement unless backed by telemetry.
verification_prompt: Can values above three digits and stale measurements be displayed honestly?

observation: Gold folding planes and a flowing botanical diagonal frame reserve and review.
lesson: Rhythm and asymmetry offer a bounded compositional lesson, not a complete account of Rinpa.
verification_prompt: Keep cultural claims tied to the source and all numerical values on undistorted planes.

observation: Three prominent silo heights sit beside a separate exact-value manifest.
lesson: Quantitative-looking silhouettes create avoidable ambiguity even with a decorative disclaimer.
verification_prompt: Make silos equal-height or remove them if viewers infer that height encodes byte size.

observation: Offset circular bands surround the reserve value beside exact labels.
lesson: Rings near numerical storage data strongly suggest a chart; separate the motif from metrics or replace it.
verification_prompt: Ask for the meaning of each arc; reject the composition if users invent percentages.

observation: Room-like orthogonal compartments organize categories alongside an exact manifest.
lesson: Spatial grouping can communicate structure, but room area competes with the nearby treemap convention.
verification_prompt: Can users state that the floorplan expresses grouping rather than measured capacity?

observation: A large pink portico frames reserve information while plain evidence sits beside it.
lesson: A theatrical threshold may suit onboarding; its columns and roof consume valuable review space.
verification_prompt: Check whether the doorway suggests an action and reduce it on dense work screens.

observation: Category plaques use museum-like labels and unequal frame widths.
lesson: Interpretive labels can connect amount and reason, but institutional styling is not certification.
verification_prompt: Can users locate uncertainty as easily as the large exhibit-like number?

observation: The render prominently says MAKE ROOM FOR YOUR NEXT IDEA beside a metric rail, rather than mapping KEEP and REVIEW as described.
lesson: Revise the semantic-map claim to match the actual typographic poster, or build the missing zones later.
verification_prompt: Verify the artifact contains each semantic relationship named in its rationale.

observation: Three specimen-like shapes use leader lines to attach category names and estimates.
lesson: Callouts can associate evidence with an object, but these shapes are placeholders, not inspected file specimens.
verification_prompt: Require a real path or provenance field before presenting a file-level conclusion.

observation: A 34.6 GB enclosing area splits into 31.2 GB and 3.4 GB with direct labels.
lesson: Use proportional area for candidate composition and exact text for close comparison.
verification_prompt: Can users identify the 34.6 GB denominator and explain why the map is not the whole disk?

observation: A parent band labeled 34.6 GB sits above child bands whose widths encode shares.
lesson: Adjacency exposes depth without nested boxes; repeated parent and child values must not be summed together.
verification_prompt: Can users explain that parent width is the same total represented by the child widths?

observation: Two unequal streams converge toward a 34.6 GB review total.
lesson: Contribution flow can explain a sum, but directional movement can imply completed reclamation.
verification_prompt: Can users describe the streams as candidate estimates and not space already recovered?

observation: A zero-baseline arithmetic bridge shows 63.9 plus 31.2 plus 3.4 yielding a possible 98.5 GB.
lesson: A waterfall makes the residual shortfall visible after all candidates are counted.
verification_prompt: Can users calculate the remaining 51.5 GB and state why 98.5 is conditional?

observation: Two labeled endpoints share a horizontal 0–35 GB scale.
lesson: Aligned position supports direct magnitude comparison with less decoding than area.
verification_prompt: Can users read 3.4 and 31.2 exactly without treating the larger category as safer?

observation: Current, possible and target markers share a 0–150 GB linear ruler.
lesson: A common axis is a compact way to compare status against a chosen reserve.
verification_prompt: Can users explain that 150 GB is the selected target, not total disk capacity?

observation: A 100-cell mosaic shows 42.6 percent of a 150 GB target beside exact text.
lesson: A fixed unit key makes a mosaic interpretable; one cell is 1.5 GB and not a file.
verification_prompt: Can users convert a cell to GB and understand the fractional final cell without counting every square?

observation: A parent total and split outer ring represent 34.6 GB of candidates with a legend.
lesson: Radial hierarchy is useful for enclosure and depth, but angle comparison needs an exact list alternative.
verification_prompt: Can users state the denominator and identify the small category without estimating an angle?

observation: Columns distinguish To inspect, Reviewed and Excluded; Reviewed starts empty.
lesson: Candidate discovery and authorization are distinct states that must remain distinct during interaction.
verification_prompt: Ensure dragging a card cannot silently approve deletion or fabricate a completed check.

observation: One evidence accordion is open while a consequence note remains outside its collapsed sections.
lesson: Disclose optional detail progressively; keep every mandatory consequence visible without extra expansion.
verification_prompt: Close every section and verify that exclusion and the current action's effect remain readable.

observation: Three columns retain volume, category and selected-record context.
lesson: Persistent ancestry can reduce backtracking for hierarchical browsing.
verification_prompt: Traverse a deep path by keyboard and confirm selected ancestors remain identifiable.

observation: One central review card sits below three numbered checkpoints.
lesson: Concentrating on one decision can reduce competing content, but progress must reflect actual completed checks.
verification_prompt: Can users move back without losing context and identify which steps are still unperformed?

observation: Two facing bars compare current 63.9 GB with conditional 98.5 GB against the same target reference.
lesson: Separate current and possible states explicitly, keeping the shortfall visible in both.
verification_prompt: Ask which number is measured and which assumes full candidate recovery.

observation: A vertical itinerary names Inspect, Decide and Measure with evidence notes.
lesson: A real sequence teaches when verification happens; measurement belongs after the action as well as before it.
verification_prompt: Can users identify the first unresolved stage without assuming any stage has completed?

observation: A matrix displays candidate size beside unknown ownership and active-use states.
lesson: Evidence completeness should be inspectable independently of the amount potentially reclaimed.
verification_prompt: Can a user find an unknown check before being attracted to the largest estimate?

observation: Indented rows and branch guides expose candidate hierarchy next to a detail note.
lesson: An outline can scale hierarchy compactly if disclosure, selection and focus are separate states.
verification_prompt: Test expand, collapse and selection with keyboard and a screen reader in the native prototype.

observation: A circular lens isolates a 31.2 GB amount while adjacent text explains file-level review.
lesson: Focus is useful when context remains reachable; magnifying a number alone adds little evidence.
verification_prompt: Replace the amount with a selected record and compare against a normal inspector.

observation: Three parallel glass-like slides sit on a luminous ruled field with opaque labels.
lesson: Parallel planes can support comparison if text and focus stay on stable opaque surfaces.
verification_prompt: Check all three labels across background changes and provide a non-layered comparison mode.

observation: Angular facets surround a quiet rectangular reserve opening.
lesson: A distinctive perimeter can hold identity outside the evidence surface.
verification_prompt: Ensure facets are never read as capacity segments and do not steal space from file evidence.

observation: The render shows CURRENT and POSSIBLE panels behind alternating stripes, rather than three selectable views described in metadata.
lesson: Treat it as a striped before/possible composition; the promised view-switching behavior is absent.
verification_prompt: Align the rationale with two visible states and remove stripe interference from labels.

observation: Three connected paper folds name Inspect, Decide and Measure above a flat evidence region.
lesson: Connected form can reinforce sequence if perspective does not distort text or imply completion.
verification_prompt: Read the steps without the paper metaphor and verify the same sequence remains clear.

observation: Interleaved pale bands cross rows pairing estimates with unanswered evidence questions.
lesson: Tracing rows is useful; weave must support table alignment instead of becoming decoration over values.
verification_prompt: Track one row across all columns at enlarged text and check that no band obscures unknown states.
